'''''Fraxinus griffithii''''', the '''Himalayan ash''' or '''evergreen ash''' is a species of flowering tree. It has been recorded in the Philippines, Indonesia, Vietnam, Myanmar, Taiwan, China, Bangladesh and India. This plant is commonly  grown as an [[ornamental plant|ornamental]] in Australia, where it is an [[Invasive species in Australia|invasive species]].<ref>{{cite web |title=''Fraxinus griffithii'', Weeds of Australia|access-date=January 23, 2018|last= Queensland Government|url=https://keyserver.lucidcentral.org/weeds/data/media/Html/fraxinus_griffithii.htm}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |title=''Fraxinus griffithii''|access-date=January 23, 2018|last= The Plant List.
